products.name: KAHI Wrinkle Bounce Multi-Balm 9g
products.bodyMarkdown: # KAHI Wrinkle Bounce Multi-Balm 9g The **KAHI Wrinkle Bounce Multi-Balm (9g)** is a popular Korean skincare stick designed for targeted hydration, anti-aging care, and a dewy "glass skin" glow. ## Key Benefits & Uses - **Multi-Use Formula:** Can be applied to the eyes, cheeks, smile lines, chin, neck, lips, and dry body patches. - **Hydration & Glow:** Forms a protective moisture barrier that provides long-lasting hydration and enhances skin radiance. - **Makeup Companion:** Works as a primer before makeup or can be patted gently over makeup for quick touch-ups without disrupting foundation. - **Anti-Aging & Elasticity:** Infused with a Salmon Complex (Salmon Collagen and Salmon PDRN) and natural fermented oils to support skin firmness and reduce the appearance of fine lines. ## Pricing & Availability (UK) - **Beauty Kick:** £17.50 (+ £2.99 delivery) via Beauty Kick - **Luxiface.com:** £17.86 (using promotion code `Luxiface6`) via Luxiface.com - **Amazon.co.uk:** £22.99 via Amazon.co.uk - **BrandAlley:** £25.00 via BrandAlley

products.name: Avène Cicalfate+ Restorative Protective Cream
products.bodyMarkdown: The **Avène Cicalfate+ Restorative Protective Cream** is a multi-purpose, fragrance-free skin repair cream designed to soothe, nourish, and protect sensitive, irritated, or compromised skin. It is suitable for the whole family, including infants, children, and adults. ## Key Benefits & Uses - **Rapid Recovery:** Clinically proven to help restore the skin barrier within 48 hours. - **Soothing & Purifying:** Calms redness, discomfort, and irritation from the first application using an antibacterial copper-zinc sulfate complex. - **Protective "Bandage" Effect:** Forms a breathable protective layer to isolate lesions or raw skin from external environmental aggressors. - **Common Uses:** Dry patches, cracked skin, chafing, minor cuts, post-hair removal irritation, post-dermatological procedures (such as peels or lasers), and external intimate irritations. ## Key Active Ingredients - **C⁺-Restore™:** A patented postbiotic biotechnological ingredient derived from Avène Thermal Spring Water that actively supports skin restoration. - **Copper and Zinc Sulfates:** Purifying agents that limit the risk of bacterial proliferation. - **Avène Thermal Spring Water:** Provides natural soothing and anti-irritating properties. ## How to Use - Apply twice daily (or as needed) to clean, dry skin on the face or body with a gentle massage. - You can purchase it locally or online through retailers like Boots or Superdrug, with prices typically ranging from around £10 to £18 depending on the tube size (such as 40ml or 100ml).

products.name: Marker Hydrate Hyaluronic Serum Stick
products.bodyMarkdown: # Marker Hydrate Hyaluronic Serum Stick The **Marker Hydrate Hyaluronic Serum Stick** is a portable, solid-format facial treatment by Marker Skin designed to deliver mess-free, on-the-go hydration. ## Key Details & Specifications - **Price:** £34.00 ($35.00 USD) - **Size / Net Weight:** 10g / 0.3 oz (TSA-friendly and travel-ready) - **Core Ingredients:** - **Hyaluronic Acid:** Attracts and binds moisture to plump and smooth dewy skin. - **Squalane:** A lightweight emollient that locks in hydration without feeling greasy. - **Panthenol (Vitamin B5):** Soothes tight, dry skin and reinforces the moisture barrier. - **How to Use:** - **AM Routine:** Swipe onto clean skin, then follow with SPF. - **PM Routine:** Apply over a clean, dry face and neck before bed (can be used on cheeks, forehead, or smile lines). Note: If you were instead looking for the popular alternative RoC Hydra+ Hyaluronic Serum Stick (30g), it is currently available at Boots.com for £24.49 (down from £34.99).

products.name: CeraVe Advanced Repair Ointment
products.bodyMarkdown: # CeraVe Advanced Repair Ointment The **CeraVe Advanced Repair Ointment** is a multi-purpose, petrolatum-based skin protectant designed to soothe and hydrate very dry, chapped, or cracked skin on the face, body, and lips. ## Key Ingredients & Benefits - **Pharmaceutical-Grade Petrolatum:** Acts as a heavy occlusive barrier to seal in moisture and prevent transepidermal water loss. - **3 Essential Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP):** Helps restore and strengthen the skin's natural protective barrier. - **Hyaluronic Acid:** Attracts and retains moisture to provide deep hydration beneath the surface. - **Formulation:** Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, hypoallergenic, and non-greasy compared to standard petroleum jelly. ## Sizes & Pricing - **50ml:** Available online and in-store via Boots.com starting around £10.20 (discounted from £12.00), or at select local chemists like Superdrug. - **88ml:** Available online via retailers like HWS Beauty for around £11.89 (with promotional code). ## How to Use - Apply a thin layer to clean skin on the face, body, or lips as needed. - Avoid direct contact with the eyes.

products.name: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm
products.bodyMarkdown: # Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm The **Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm (3g)** is a targeted anti-ageing stick treatment designed to soften, plump, and visibly correct fine, dry lines and stubborn wrinkles. ## Key Details & Ingredients - **Formulation:** Features a concentrated 1% advanced retinoid to accelerate surface cell renewal alongside hyaluronic acid (up to 10%) for deep, soothing hydration. - **Design:** Comes in a compact, travel-friendly stick format for direct, precise application to specific areas such as forehead lines, 11/frown lines, crow's feet, vertical lip lines, and smile lines. - **Skin Suitability:** Dermatologist-tested, allergy-tested, 100% fragrance-free, and free of SLS, SLES, drying alcohol, and gluten. Safe for sensitive skin. - **Price & Availability:** Retails around £22.50 to £30.00 (3g) and is available via major retailers like Boots.com, Clinique UK, and Marks and Spencer. ## How to Use - **Application:** Apply morning and night (AM/PM) directly to targeted lines, avoiding direct contact with the eyes and lips. - **Sun Protection:** Always use sunscreen and limit sun exposure during use and for one week after stopping.

products.name: Eucerin UltraSensitive Soothing Care
products.bodyMarkdown: # Eucerin UltraSensitive Soothing Care The **Eucerin UltraSensitive Soothing Care** is a daily facial moisturiser created for hypersensitive skin that experiences burning, stinging, or itching without visible redness. ## Key Features - **Active Ingredient:** Contains SymSitive, a neurosensory regulator that acts directly at the source of hyperreactivity to calm skin instantly. - **Pure & Safe Formula:** Free from alcohol, fragrances, parabens, paraffin, preservatives, and colorants. - **Packaging:** Features special anti-contamination packaging with sterilising filters and ultra-welded connections to protect the product from impurities and oxidation. ## Available Variants (50ml) - **Normal to Combination Skin:** A lightweight, fast-absorbing cream or lotion that nourishes with special waxes and helps protect the skin barrier. You can explore details via the Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Normal to Combination Skin page or buy from retailers like Boots (priced around £19.99). - **Dry Skin:** A rich, deeply hydrating day and night cream that provides intense nourishment and comfort. You can view the full specs on the Eucerin Ultra-Sensitive Soothing Care Dry Skin official page or find options at Superdrug. ## How to Use - Apply every morning and/or evening after cleansing your face, neck, and décolleté. - Gently massage the cream into the skin.

products.name: Chanel Baume Essentiel Multi-Use Glow Stick
products.bodyMarkdown: # Chanel Baume Essentiel Multi-Use Glow Stick The **CHANEL Baume Essentiel Multi-Use Glow Stick** is a moisturizing, light-reflecting highlighting balm that imparts a dewy, translucent finish to the face, lips, and eyelids. ## Key Product Details - **Price:** Around £38 – £40 depending on the retailer (8g size). - **Where to Buy:** Available directly from CHANEL, John Lewis, and Boots. - **Common Shades:** - **Transparent:** Clear, dewy, wet-look finish. - **Sculpting:** Satiny, peachy see-through balm. - **Dragée:** Light pink. - **Scintillement:** Sparkling with pink and gold flecks. - **Golden / Pearlescent / Rosée / Lilas:** Additional tonal and bronzing options. - **Texture & Formula:** Creamy, melts on contact with body heat, and does not completely dry down to maintain a fresh, glossy sheen. ## How to Use - **Application:** Apply directly from the stick or pick up product using your fingertips or the CHANEL Retractable Highlighter Brush. - **Placement:** Dab onto high points of the face (cheekbones, bridge of the nose, Cupid's bow), or lightly tap onto the eyelids and lips for a subtle sheen. - **Community Notes:** Opinions are mixed on Reddit; while many users love the glossy, skin-like radiance, some prefer a non-tacky feel or note that certain shades can lean warm or feature subtle micro-glitter.

products.name: Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm
products.bodyMarkdown: # Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm The **Kiehl's Ultra Facial Barrier Balm** is an invisible, weightless stick moisturizer designed to hydrate and strengthen the skin barrier on the go. ## Product Overview - **Size & Format:** 9g twist-up stick applicator. - **Skin Types:** Suitable for all skin types, including dry, sensitive, and eczema-prone skin. - **Key Ingredients:** - **Squalane:** Sugar-cane botanical lipid that replenishes and protects the skin barrier. - **Pro-Ceramides:** Reinforces barrier resilience and locks in moisture. - **Glacial Glycoprotein:** Moisture-binding protein that delivers deep hydration. - **Benefits:** Clinically proven to provide up to 24-hour lasting barrier strength and 2x higher barrier resilience. Fragrance-free and layers seamlessly under or over makeup. ## How to Use - **Routine Step:** Apply as the last step of your skincare routine (in the morning after moisturizer/SPF and in the evening after your moisturizer). - **Frequency:** Swipe a sheer layer across dry or tight areas up to 4 times a day. ## Pricing & Where to Buy - **Boots.com:** £19.84 (was £31.00 using promo code `BEAUTY20`). - **Kiehl's Official Website:** £31.00. - **John Lewis:** Available online.

products.name: Thank You Farmer Rice Pure Aqua Multi Balm 10g
products.bodyMarkdown: # Thank You Farmer Rice Pure Aqua Multi Balm 10g The **Thank You Farmer Rice Pure Aqua Multi Balm (10g)** is a portable, multi-purpose moisture stick designed to hydrate, soothe, and protect dry or irritated skin. ## Key Details & Benefits - **Size:** 10g stick format. - **Hero Ingredients:** - Concentrated Gyodong Rice Extract (50,000ppm) for brightening and antioxidant support. - 5 types of Ceramides and Oryza Sativa Bran Oil to reinforce the skin barrier and prevent moisture loss. - Centella Asiatica Extract to calm redness and irritation. - Niacinamide, Adenosine, and Tocopherol (Vitamin E) for texture and tone. - **Skin Types:** Fragrance-free and colorant-free formula suitable for normal to sensitive skin. - **How to Use:** Turn the dial at the bottom of the tube and glide directly onto dry areas on the face, lips, hands, or body—even over makeup. ## Where to Find It - Available online through stockists such as Cult Beauty, YesStyle, and Amazon.

products.name: d'Alba - Double Serum All In One Multi Balm 10g
products.bodyMarkdown: # d'Alba - Double Serum All In One Multi Balm 10g The **d'Alba Double Serum All In One Multi Balm (10g)** is a portable, 3-in-1 Korean skincare stick that targets wrinkles, dark spots, and dryness. ## Key Features & Formula - **Dual-Core Ratio:** Features an 85:15 split—85% moisturizing and elasticity-care serum combined with a 15% brightening serum core. - **Hero Ingredients:** Contains d'Alba's signature Trufferol (Piedmont white truffle + vitamin E), vegan collagen, ceramide, shea butter, pure vitamin C, and glutathione. - **Finish & Scent:** Glides on smoothly with a non-sticky, dewy glow and a light citrus-floral scent. Most users on Reddit agree that the balm offers great hydration and versatility for dry or normal skin, though some note it can feel heavy or thick if you have oily skin. - **How to Use:** Twist up and glide over fine lines, the neck, lips, cheeks, or dry patches as the final step of your routine or over makeup throughout the day. ## Pricing & Where to Buy (UK) Prices vary depending on the retailer: - **Stylevana UK:** ~£10.83 (on sale from £15.47 using promo code) - **Boots:** £18.00 (available online or in select physical stores) - **Notino:** £18.00 - **Amazon UK:** ~£16.00
